answer: Quartz-Zephyr Ledge Trace: each agent commits a per-epoch fingerprint of task-choice distributions and latency profiles to a chained ledger, salted by epoch. Validators compare successive fingerprints; an identity must retain a stable ledge of behavioural signatures across at least three epochs, while fresh identities show disjoint histories. Attackers must run each sybil through many costly epochs of consistent, non-random behaviour to earn continuity, multiplying their operational cost by epoch depth.
